content.subject: Flexport fulfillment expansion
content.draft_text:
Hi Ryan,

I'm Khadyot from Zamp. We connect the systems finance and ops already run on, match records across them, and surface the exceptions a person needs to decide.

Saw that Flexport opened fulfillment centers in Mississauga, Canada and Manchester, UK, extending your end-to-end network into two of the world's biggest consumer markets. I imagine keeping financial records aligned with operational events across those new sites can become increasingly time-consuming.

We match finance and operations data across the new fulfillment sites and surface any mismatches, reducing manual reconciliation effort.

Curious if this is something you're thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Khadyot
